questions.prompt: Explain the difference between pollination and fertilisation in flowering plants.
questions.modelAnswer: Pollination is the transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma. Fertilisation happens later: the pollen grain grows a tube down the style to an ovule, and a male gamete from the pollen fuses with the female gamete (egg) inside the ovule to form a zygote.
